style: Say with bright, encouraging energy, like a friendly superhero coach
lines: Here's a short dance to start. Press Play to watch it, then tap a block and try a device.
Before is on the left, now is on the right. Press Play both and watch what your change did.
Nothing has changed yet. Tap Build, then tap a block and try a device.
Show time. Press Play to see the whole dance from the audience.
Now tap a spot on the timeline to place it.
Now tap a device in the panel to change how this block is danced.
You made a change. Tap Compare to see before and after side by side.
Tap a count slot, then pick a move. Press Try it, then Save phrase when it feels right.
Repeat: saying it twice makes it matter.
Retrograde: the phrase runs backwards, last count first.
Mirror: right becomes left.
Level: same phrase, new height.
Tempo: same moves, new speed.
Dynamics: same shapes, new energy.
Size: same moves, more or less space.
Canon: dancers start one after another, like a round.
Canon needs two dancers or more. Tap Dancers 2 first.
That makes the dance too long. Remove a block first.
Phrase saved. You'll find it with the starters.
Tap a timeline block, then tap a device to revise it.
Tap Dancers or a Formation to change the selected block.
Choose a phrase, then tap a plus on the timeline to place it. Or tap Make a phrase.
Type a Dance title, or choose an available history control.
Choose a Before version, then press Play both.
Read what changed, then press Play both to watch the difference.
Choose a reason for this version, or type a short note.
Keep the phrase; change its height. Tap Level option, or press Play.
Half time doubles the counts; Double time halves them. Tap Tempo option, or press Play.
Keep the shapes; change their energy. Tap Dynamics option, or press Play.
Use more or less space for the same moves. Tap Size option, or press Play.
Start dancers one or two counts apart. Tap Canon option, or press Play.
